title: Claude just did something UNTHINKABLE
description:
Claude Code just got way less annoying.

The problem: rate limits kept killing your workflow.

The fix: doubled 5-hour limits, no peak hour throttling, and higher Opus API limits.

The outcome: more building, less waiting.

Thank SpaceX, I guess.
